style: oil painting, painterly brushwork, warm naturalistic light, storybook illustration in the manner of early-1900s children's book plates, composed simply with one clear subject and uncluttered midground
negative: no text, letters, signage or lettering of any kind
no people or figures unless the scene text names them
no caves, doors, openings, paths or structures the scene text does not name
no ruby slippers - the shoes are SILVER
no green-skinned witch, no broomstick, no crystal ball
no modern objects, no lens flare, no visible frame or border
notes: Baum's 1900 novel is the only source. The 1939 film is not public domain and its iconography must not appear; see STUDY.md section 8 for the full contamination checklist.
